# WebUI icon dependencies

- Morphicons 1.7.1: https://github.com/guillermolg00/morphicons (MIT). The three files in morphicons/ are unmodified npm distribution files.
- Lucide 1.28.0: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide (ISC, with Feather-derived MIT icons). Only 24 icon definitions are included in ../icon-data.js.

Both official npm tarballs were verified against their sha512 integrity and sha1 shasum before copying. No CDN, framework, Node.js, or package installation is needed at runtime. These assets are included by the desktop release packager.
